snippet.title: DEATHMOON Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello!! Another game??

DEATHMOON is my new project I've been working on. It is a roguelike boomer shooter heavily inspired by Isaac and ULTRAKILL. I've been developing this game ever since I took a break from Courier 79 (which is still on hold). I'm really enjoying making this game and so far it's turning out great.

Anyways, you can PLAYTEST the game for free HERE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3848800/DEATHMOON/
Click on the green 'Request Access' button and you will be auto-accepted into the playtest.

Also here is my discord server if you want to stay updated about the game: https://discord.gg/VPKGVuz

Hope you enjoy this new thing.
